scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.bundle:api: npx esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=api/index.js --external:@prisma/client
